video_summary.overall_goal: Enable battery temperature logging with custom duration entry
video_summary.description: User navigates Battery Temperature app, manually enters logging duration via numeric keyboard (3 minutes), starts logging, waits for completion, receives completion toast, and navigates to Play Store.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Battery Temperature app main screen with current temp 18.5°C, graph, and logging controls
Same main screen, numeric keyboard appears after user taps duration field
Duration field shows numeric input being entered
visible_ui_elements: Log for field now shows '2', keyboard visible

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Duration field updated, user completes numeric entry
visible_ui_elements: Log for field now shows '3', keyboard visible
Button text changed to 'STOP LOGGING' (indicating logging started)
steps.system_response: Additional numeric input entered (value: 3), logging initiated
steps.visual_feedback: Text updated in field, button state changes
steps.intent_task: Complete duration entry and initiate logging

steps.what_screen_is_visible: App continues logging, temperature graph updates
visible_ui_elements: Numeric keyboard remains visible during logging
steps.system_response: App processes 3-minute logging sequence, temperature data collected

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Device navigates to Play Store app page for BatteryTemperatureDisplay
steps.system_response: Device navigates away from Battery Temperature app to Play Store

overall_flow: 1. User observes initial app state with default settings
2. User taps on Log for duration field to open numeric input
3. User enters duration value '2' via numeric keyboard
4. User updates duration to '3' and logging automatically starts (STOP LOGGING button appears)
5. App logs temperature for 3 minutes while keyboard remains visible
6. Logging completes and shows 'Temperature logging finished' toast
7. Device navigates to Play Store app page
human_readable_step_summary: Initial app state showing logging controls and current temperature 18.5°C
Open numeric keyboard by tapping duration field
Enter first digit '2' via keyboard input
Enter second digit '3' via keyboard, logging automatically starts with 3-minute duration
Logging runs for 3 minutes with temperature updates visible in graph (up to 19.1°C)
Logging completes with 'Temperature logging finished' confirmation toast
Navigation to Play Store app details page
